Adapted circuit current limiting principle from EVCC
https://github.com/evcc-io/evcc/tree/9404d825d6a659d8ce7f47d3b0d2e14ac04506e0
core/circuit/circuit.go (ValidateCurrent), adapted per physical phase.
core/soc/estimator.go (SoC estimation) and estimator_test.go reference vectors,
ported to backend/app/engine/evcc_soc.py and tests/backend/test_evcc_soc.py.
Peugeot timestamps are deliberately not an input to the EVCC estimator.
core/loadpoint.go (effectiveCurrent, fixed-phase pvMaxCurrent, setLimit minimum
current behavior), adapted in backend/app/engine/evcc_loadpoint.py and engine.py.
ValidateCurrent is now fed independent current measurements, with 0.1A profiles.
